1.w: “Be silent before Me, O islands, and the peoples will renew [their] strength; let them draw near, then let them speak; together let us come near for judgment.

2.w: Who has roused one from the east? Righteousness calls him at His feet; He gives the nations before his face, and he subdues kings; he makes [them] like dust with his sword, driven away as stubble [by] his bow.

3.w: He pursues them, passing over in peace, a path he does not enter with his feet.

4.w: Who has worked and accomplished? The One calling the generations from the beginning: “I [am] YHWH, the first and the last; I [am] He!”

5.w: The islands have seen [it] and feared; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward:

6.w: Each man helps his neighbor and says to his brother, “Be strong.”

7.w: And the craftsman strengthens the goldsmith, the one smoothing [with] the hammer, the one striking the anvil, saying of the joining, “It [is] Good!”—And he strengthens it with nails, and it will not be toppled.

8.w: “And you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, seed of Abraham My friend,

9.w: whom I have taken from the ends of the earth and called you from its corners, and said to you ‘You [are] My servant, I have chosen you and not rejected you’—

10.w: do not be afraid, for I [am] with you; do not look around, for I [am] your God. I have strengthened you; yes, I have helped you—yes, have I taken hold of you with the right hand of My righteousness.

11.w: Behold, all those burning against you, they will be ashamed and disgraced; they will be as nothing, and the men of your dispute will perish.

12.w: You will seek them, and will not find them, the men of your dispute will be as nothing, the men of your warfare as nothing at all.

13.w: For I [am] YHWH your God, taking hold of your right hand, saying to you: Do not fear; I have helped you!

14.w: Do not fear, O worm of Jacob, O men of Israel; I have helped you, a declaration of YHWH, And your Redeemer [is] the Holy One of Israel.

15.w: Behold, I am making you sharp, into a new threshing sledge, an owner of teeth; [and] you will thresh the mountains and crush [them], and you will make the hills like chaff.

16.w: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the tempest will scatter them; and you will rejoice in YHWH; you will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

17.w: The poor and the needy seek water, and there is none; their tongues are dry with thirst. I, YHWH, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

18.w: I will open rivers on the barren heights, and fountains in the middle of the valleys; I will make the desert into a pool of water, and the dry land into flowing springs of water.

19.w: I will plant the cedar in the wilderness, and the acacia, and the myrtle, and the olive tree; I will place in the desert plain the cypress, elm, and boxwood together—

20.w: that they may see and know, and consider and understand together, that the hand of YHWH has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”

21.w: “Bring near your⁺ case,” says YHWH; “Put forth your⁺ arguments,” says the King of Jacob.

22.w: “Let them approach, and declare to us what will happen. The former [things], what [were] they? Declare [it], that we may set [it] [in] our heart and know the last things; or declare to us the coming things.

23.w: Declare the things to come hereafter, that we may know if you⁺ [are] gods; yes, do good or do evil, that we may look and see together.

24.w: Behold, you⁺ [are] nothing, and your⁺ work [is] worthless—an abomination [is] he who chooses you⁺!

25.w: I have roused one from the north, and he has come from the rising of the sun; he calls on My name, and he comes in against princes like [they were] mortar, and like the potter treads the clay.

26.w: Who has declared [this] from the beginning, that we might know, and from before the face, that we may say, ‘[He is] right? Surely, no one declared [it]; surely, no one proclaimed [it]; surely no one heard your⁺ words.

27.w: First to Zion—behold, behold them!—And to Jerusalem, I will give one bringing news.

28.w: For I looked, and [there was] no man; among them, and no one was counseling, that I might ask them, and they could answer a word.

29.w: Behold, all of them [are] delusion; their works [are] nothing, their molten images are wind and emptiness.
